ratification.note: BACKFILLED. This file predates ratification being a recorded act. It was classified ratified by INFERENCE — the gate observed that all four operator-declared fields were present and treated that shape as consent. Who declared these values, and when, is not recorded anywhere in this repository or its history. This block states that weak provenance explicitly rather than leaving an inference to be silently restated as a ratification. `overrides` lists the values as they already stood; `kind: backfilled` means the value was read out of the file, not declared at this ratification.

_meta.corpus_absent_reason: NOT PERSISTED — gone. Captured 2026-08-14 with the extractor repaired by clearVisibilityGate() (70a09f97), but no corpus was committed: `ls benchmarks/captures` -> No such file or directory, and a repo-wide find for extraction.json returns nothing outside node_modules. Census §1.2. The numbers in this file are therefore NOT re-derivable, and several of them were finished by hand in any case (census §3). The nearest re-derivable artifact is benchmarks/enterprise-stablecoin-payments-measured.json, compiled from a persisted corpus of the same five bvnk.com pages.
_meta.corpus_absent_consequence: Every number in this file is therefore an assertion with no evidence behind it that this repository can replay. It is kept because builds depend on it, not because it is verifiable. Do not cite it as measured without saying that the measurement cannot be reproduced.
_meta.note: PATTERNS ONLY. No markup, copy, asset, SVG or shader is lifted from the reference. Numbers below are measured frequencies over rendered computed styles.
_meta.capture_caveat: bvnk.com paints nothing to this crawler: a Webflow/GeoTargetly anti-flicker gate injects '.<HIDE_CLASS> body{visibility:hidden!important}' and its reveal never fires (HIDE_CLASS stringifies to 'undefined'; the live markup carries class="w-mod-js undefined w-mod-ix"). Every measurement here was taken after clearing that gate — see clearVisibilityGate() in scripts/quality/lib/extract-reference.js. These are the styles as authored, not as served.

page_selection_rationale.home: HERO, NAV, FOOTER, CTA, LOGO-BAR, display type scale
page_selection_rationale.about-us: ABOUT, TEAM, section rhythm at its most generous

_meta.supersedes: consumer-crypto-robinhood.json — ratified 2026-08-14 as the consumer-crypto benchmark, superseded the same day when the target site was changed to bvnk.com. That benchmark is dark (bg_primary #000000); this one is light. They cannot both be authoritative, and a build that mixes them produces the invisible-accent class of failure.

_source.bg_primary: bvnk page ground, 17 elements measured white; the hero is a white-to-pale-blue gradient over this ground
_source.bg_secondary: bvnk banding background, 21 elements, 1.06:1 step from bg_primary — the pale blue section band
_source.surface: bvnk neutral card surface, 22 elements, 12.55:1 with text_primary
_source.text_primary: bvnk body and heading colour, 516 occurrences, 13.98:1 on bg_primary
_source.text_muted: bvnk secondary text colour, 163 occurrences, 7.34:1 on bg_primary
_source.border: bvnk measured borderColor on borderWidth>0, 21 elements, 1.13:1 from bg_primary — a separator, not an outline
_source.surface_inverse: bvnk dark accent ground, 17 elements measured #242d35 (a further 10 at #080a0c). A light benchmark still needs a named dark surface: sections like the CTA band are dark ON PURPOSE, and deriving that from text_primary makes the section's identity a side effect of the palette — a dark compiled palette would then silently produce a white 'dark-band'. 13.98:1 with on_accent white
_source._border_emphasis_excluded: #242d35 measured on 48 elements is the dark pill/button outline, an emphasis stroke rather than a separator; using it as `border` would put button-weight strokes on every card edge
_source._reference_accent_not_adopted: bvnk's own accent is #0b57f4 (71 text occurrences, 15 backgrounds). It is NOT adopted: accent carries tenant identity, and Cape Crypto is FSP No. 53746 trading under its own mark, not a BVNK sub-brand
_source.accent: capecrypto.com tenant identity rgb(0,78,137) — NOT from reference

_source.ratio: geometric ratio across the measured 13px-96px range over 8 steps
_source.heading_weight: every measured H1/H2 renders at 500 — the reference never uses bold for display type; 700 appears on 24 inline elements only
_source.display_sizes: H2 at 64px (13 occurrences) and 96px (7); a single H1 at 165px on the home hero is an outlier and is not carried into the scale

_source.section_py_px: 120px/0px measured on 13 full-width blocks; 180px/0px (25) is hero-specific top padding and 304px (8) is the home hero alone — carrying either as the section default would double the page height of every content section
_source.block_gap_px: 24px, the dominant measured flex/grid gap, 200 elements
_source.grid_px: every measured gap (4/8/16/20/24/28/40/48/80) is divisible by 4

card_system._source: measured borderRadius on backgrounded surfaces: 16px (56), 32px (16), 24px (9). 100px (79) and 100% (22) are pills and avatars, carried in cta_buttons rather than here

cta_buttons._source: 100px measured on 79 elements — the reference is unambiguously a full-pill button system

shadow_system.observation: 5 shadowed elements measured, all a single soft layer: rgba(22,22,78,0.1) 0px 1px 8px 0px. Elevation is carried by surface tint and radius, not by shadow

font_system.substitution_reason: Circular and CircularXX cannot be served, so declaring them made dna_font_families a rule that could only ever fail — against a face no build can load. `families` now declares what the build serves and what the gate checks; `measured_families` keeps what the reference actually renders, so the substitution stays auditable. Precedence is intact: the benchmark still owns the font role. Operator decision, Craig, 2026-08-17. If the Lineto faces are licensed and hosted, restore measured_families as families and add the @font-face.
font_system._source: Circular (556 text elements) and CircularXX (447). Both are proprietary Lineto faces and cannot be loaded. font_match.py resolves Circular to Poppins on genre geometric-sans; CircularXX returns UNMATCHED because the name signals no genre, so its role must be assigned deliberately rather than guessed. Note the reference's own declared fallback chain is 'Circular, Inter, sans-serif' — Inter is a neo-grotesque and a poorer geometric match than Poppins, so the matcher's choice is kept and this disagreement is recorded rather than silently resolved.

motion._source: animation detector scored 39.2 'expressive' at 100% confidence; GSAP with ScrollTrigger, SplitText, Draggable, Inertia, Observer, CustomEase and Lottie all present
